slides.title: PREACHER CURL · BAYESIAN CURL
slides.body: Hard on the biceps where they're stretched. Strict, easy to load, hard to cheat.

slides.title: OVERHEAD TRICEPS EXTENSION
slides.body: Trains the long head of the triceps in a stretch. Most people skip it.

slides.title: HAMMER CURL · CABLE PUSHDOWN
slides.body: Hammer curls hit the brachialis on the side of the arm. Pushdowns are easy to progress.

slides.title: CONCENTRATION CURL · KICKBACK
slides.body: Fine, but hard to load heavy. Easy to plateau on.

slides.title: CHEAT CURLS
slides.body: If your whole body swings the weight up, your arms aren't doing the work.
